Northwind Analytics pricing

Northwind Analytics costs 49 USD per month on the Team plan and 199 USD per month on the Scale plan. Both plans are billed monthly, include unlimited users, and start with a 14-day trial that does not require a card.

Team — 49 USD per month

Up to 50 monitored tables, email and Slack alerts, 30 days of run history. Suited to a single data engineering team running scheduled pipelines in one warehouse.

Scale — 199 USD per month

Up to 500 monitored tables, PagerDuty and webhook alerts, 12 months of run history, and per-team alert routing. Suited to organisations running pipelines across several warehouses.

Start a trial

Questions about pricing

Every plan includes the same alerting engine; the plans differ only in monitored table count and history retention. If you need more than 500 tables, contact the team and we will quote against your table count.
